description: Days used only in combined programmes. An integration day is added when both technologies are requested; a capstone is used when every requested technology is in its applies_to list.

day.topic: Python on AWS: Automation with boto3 and Lambda
subtopics: Credentials from roles instead of keys
Writing a Lambda handler in Python
day.lab_task: Write a Python Lambda function with boto3 that resizes images uploaded to S3 and records metadata in DynamoDB, with unit tests that mock AWS using moto.
day.deliverable: Function code, Lambda layer, IAM policy and passing tests
checks: Upload a test image to the input bucket
Resized image and a metadata item are created
Run the unit tests with the network off
Remove the role's DynamoDB permission and upload again
Function logs a ClientError with AccessDenied and does not crash
objectives: Automate AWS from Python with boto3
Build and test Python Lambda functions
Handle AWS errors and permissions in code

day.topic: Python on Azure: Azure SDK and Azure Functions
subtopics: Azure SDK for Python client libraries
Writing an Azure Function in Python
Bindings in the Python v2 programming model
Least-privilege role assignments for Python code
day.lab_task: Write a Python Azure Function that resizes images uploaded to Blob Storage and writes metadata to Table Storage, authenticating with managed identity, with unit tests that mock the SDK.
day.deliverable: Function code, role assignments and passing tests
checks: Upload a test image to the input container
Resized image and a metadata row are created
Search the code and settings for storage keys
Remove the identity's role and upload again
Function logs an authorisation error and does not crash
objectives: Automate Azure from Python with the Azure SDK
Build and test Python Azure Functions
Authenticate Python code with managed identity

day.topic: AWS and Azure Compared: Service Mapping and Multi-Cloud Decisions
subtopics: Mapping core services between AWS and Azure
Identity: IAM compared with Entra ID and Azure RBAC
When multi-cloud helps and when it adds risk
day.lab_task: Deploy the same small container web service on AWS (ECS Fargate) and Azure (Container Apps) with Terraform, then compare setup effort, monthly cost and operational differences.
day.deliverable: Terraform code for both clouds, a service mapping table and a one-page comparison with a recommendation
checks: Same service responds on AWS and Azure
Monthly cost for both uses the official calculators with the same assumptions
Choice is justified with at least three criteria
objectives: Map AWS and Azure services to each other
Compare clouds on cost and operations with evidence
Decide when multi-cloud is justified

day.topic: Docker to Kubernetes: From Compose Stack to Cluster Deployment
subtopics: Mapping Compose services to Deployments and Services
Resource limits to requests and limits
Packaging the result as a Helm chart
day.lab_task: Move the three-tier Compose application to a local Kubernetes cluster as a Helm chart, keeping its health checks, limits, secrets and persistent data.
day.deliverable: Helm chart, mapping table from Compose to Kubernetes and a running deployment
checks: Open the app through the cluster ingress
Every Compose setting has its Kubernetes equivalent or a reason
objectives: Translate Compose applications to Kubernetes
Keep health, limits, secrets and data during the move
Package the result with Helm

day.topic: Terraform on AWS: Modules for VPC, ECS and RDS
subtopics: AWS provider configuration and assume role
Remote state in S3 with locking
VPC module with public and private subnets
day.lab_task: Build an AWS environment with Terraform modules for a VPC, an ECS Fargate service and a private RDS database, using remote state and an assumed role.
day.deliverable: Terraform repository, plan and apply outputs and the running service URL
checks: App responds and reads from RDS
Search the code for AWS keys or the database password
objectives: Provision AWS infrastructure with Terraform modules
Use roles and secrets safely
Keep AWS environments reproducible

day.topic: Terraform on Azure: Modules for VNet, Container Apps and Azure SQL
subtopics: AzureRM provider and authentication with managed identity or OIDC
VNet module with subnets and NSGs
day.lab_task: Build an Azure environment with Terraform modules for a VNet, a Container Apps service and a private Azure SQL database, using remote state and OIDC authentication.
day.deliverable: Terraform repository, plan and apply outputs and the running service URL
checks: App responds and reads from Azure SQL
Search the code for client secrets or the database password
objectives: Provision Azure infrastructure with Terraform modules
Authenticate without stored secrets
Keep Azure environments reproducible

day.topic: Terraform on Google Cloud: Modules for VPC, Cloud Run and Cloud SQL
subtopics: Google provider with service account impersonation
Plan review for Google Cloud changes
day.lab_task: Build a Google Cloud environment with Terraform modules for a VPC, a Cloud Run service and a private Cloud SQL database, using remote state and impersonation.
day.deliverable: Terraform repository, plan and apply outputs and the running service URL
checks: App responds and reads from Cloud SQL
Search the repository for key files
objectives: Provision Google Cloud infrastructure with Terraform modules
Authenticate with impersonation
Keep Google Cloud environments reproducible

day.topic: Python on Google Cloud: Client Libraries and Cloud Run
subtopics: Google Cloud client libraries for Python
Building a Python service for Cloud Run
Pub/Sub publisher and subscriber in Python
Least-privilege service accounts for Python code
day.lab_task: Write a Python service on Cloud Run that stores uploads in Cloud Storage, records metadata in Firestore and publishes an event to Pub/Sub, with tests against local emulators.
day.deliverable: Service code, deployment configuration and passing tests
checks: Upload a file through the service
File, Firestore document and Pub/Sub message are created
Run the tests with the network off
Remove the service account's Firestore role
Service logs a permission error and does not crash
objectives: Use Google Cloud from Python
Build and test Python services for Cloud Run
Authenticate Python code without keys

day.topic: AWS and Google Cloud Compared: Mapping Services, Costs and Operations
subtopics: Mapping core services between AWS and Google Cloud
IAM compared with Google Cloud IAM and the resource hierarchy
Regional VPC compared with global VPC
When multi-cloud helps and when it adds risk
Portable tooling with Terraform and containers
day.lab_task: Deploy the same container service on AWS (ECS Fargate) and Google Cloud (Cloud Run) with Terraform, then compare setup effort, monthly cost and operations.
day.deliverable: Terraform code for both clouds, a service mapping table and a one-page comparison
checks: Same service responds on both clouds
Uses the official calculators with the same assumptions
Justified with at least three criteria
objectives: Map AWS and Google Cloud services
Compare clouds on cost and operations
Decide when multi-cloud is justified

day.topic: Azure and Google Cloud Compared: Identity, Networking and Cost Differences
subtopics: Mapping core services between Azure and Google Cloud
Entra ID and Azure RBAC compared with Google Cloud IAM
When multi-cloud helps and when it adds risk
Portable tooling with Terraform and containers
day.lab_task: Deploy the same container service on Azure (Container Apps) and Google Cloud (Cloud Run) with Terraform, then compare setup effort, monthly cost and operations.
day.deliverable: Terraform code for both clouds, a service mapping table and a one-page comparison
checks: Same service responds on both clouds
Uses the official calculators with the same assumptions
Justified with at least three criteria
objectives: Map Azure and Google Cloud services
Compare clouds on cost and operations
Decide when multi-cloud is justified

day.topic: Integrated Capstone: Multi-Cloud Python Service on AWS and Azure
subtopics: Requirements and architecture for both clouds
Python API with tests and a container image
Deployment to AWS and Azure with Terraform
Secrets with Secrets Manager and Key Vault
Monitoring and alerts on both clouds
Verify acceptance criteria, cost comparison and demo
day.lab_task: Build a tested Python API, containerise it, deploy it to AWS and Azure with Terraform using each cloud's secret store and monitoring, then demonstrate failover between them and present a cost comparison.
day.deliverable: Repository with application, tests and Terraform for both clouds, monitoring screenshots, cost comparison and a 15-minute demo
checks: Run the test suite and both deployments from the pipeline
Tests pass and the API responds on both clouds
Stop the AWS deployment during the demo
Traffic is served from Azure as designed
None found; both clouds read secrets from their secret stores
objectives: Deliver one Python service on two clouds end to end
Apply security and monitoring on AWS and Azure
Compare and justify multi-cloud design choices

day.topic: Integrated Capstone: Python Service on AWS
subtopics: Deployment to Lambda or ECS with infrastructure as code
day.lab_task: Build a tested Python API and deploy it to AWS with infrastructure as code, secrets in Secrets Manager, least-privilege roles and CloudWatch alarms, then present it.
day.deliverable: Repository with application, tests and infrastructure code, dashboard and a 15-minute demo
checks: Tests pass and the API responds
objectives: Deliver a Python service on AWS end to end
Apply security and monitoring
Explain design decisions

day.topic: Integrated Capstone: Python Service on Azure
subtopics: Deployment to Container Apps or Functions with infrastructure as code
day.lab_task: Build a tested Python API and deploy it to Azure with infrastructure as code, secrets in Key Vault, managed identity and Application Insights alerts, then present it.
day.deliverable: Repository with application, tests and infrastructure code, workbook and a 15-minute demo
checks: Tests pass and the API responds
objectives: Deliver a Python service on Azure end to end
Apply security and monitoring
Explain design decisions

day.topic: Integrated Capstone: Multi-Cloud Web Application on AWS and Azure
subtopics: Requirements and architecture for both clouds
Networking and identity on each cloud
Secrets and monitoring on each cloud
Verify acceptance criteria, cost comparison and demo
day.lab_task: Deploy one containerised web application to AWS and Azure with Terraform, secure and monitor it on both, set up DNS failover, and present a cost and operations comparison.
day.deliverable: Terraform code for both clouds, monitoring screenshots, failover test and a 15-minute demo
checks: Open the application through the shared DNS name
DNS fails over to the other cloud
Both clouds are costed with the same assumptions
objectives: Deploy one application on two clouds
Apply security and monitoring on AWS and Azure
Compare clouds with evidence

day.topic: Integrated Capstone: Containerised Application from Docker to Kubernetes
subtopics: Helm chart with probes, limits and storage
day.lab_task: Build secure images for a three-tier application, deploy them to Kubernetes with a Helm chart, TLS, autoscaling and monitoring, then demonstrate a failure and recovery.
day.deliverable: Repository with Dockerfiles, Helm chart, pipeline and dashboards, plus a 15-minute demo
checks: Images build, pass scans and deploy to the cluster
Kill a node during the demo
Autoscaler adds pods and latency stays acceptable
objectives: Deliver a containerised application from image to cluster
Combine image security with Kubernetes operations
Demonstrate recovery

day.topic: Integrated Capstone: Cloud-Native Delivery with Containers, Kubernetes and Terraform
subtopics: Infrastructure and managed cluster with Terraform
Container images and supply chain checks
Kubernetes deployment with Helm or GitOps
Verify acceptance criteria, cost and demo
day.lab_task: Provision a managed Kubernetes cluster and its network with Terraform, deliver a containerised application to it through a pipeline, and demonstrate scaling, recovery and a cost estimate.
day.deliverable: Repository with Terraform, Dockerfiles, Helm chart and pipeline, plus dashboards and a 15-minute demo
checks: Destroy and recreate the environment from code
Cluster and app return with no manual steps
Monthly cost of the environment is calculated
objectives: Deliver cloud-native infrastructure and applications end to end
Combine Terraform, containers and Kubernetes
Explain cost and design choices

day.topic: Integrated Capstone: Multi-Cloud Python Service on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud
subtopics: Requirements and architecture for three clouds
Python API with tests and a container image
Deployment to each cloud with Terraform
Secrets with each cloud's secret store
Monitoring and DNS failover across clouds
Verify acceptance criteria, cost comparison and demo
day.lab_task: Build a tested Python API, containerise it, deploy it to AWS, Azure and Google Cloud with Terraform using each cloud's secret store and monitoring, demonstrate DNS failover between clouds and present a cost comparison.
day.deliverable: Repository with application, tests and Terraform for three clouds, monitoring screenshots, cost comparison and a 15-minute demo
